blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – A total of 25 fisherfolk beneficiaries in Margosatubig , Zamboanga del Sur received 11,000 kilograms of seaweed propagules Tuesday, Nov. 3, as part of government’s efforts to boost local aquaculture production and coastal livelihoods. The formal turnover and distribution activity was held in Barangay Poblacion, organized by the Office of the Municipal Agriculture in partnership with the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources – Region 9 (BFAR-9) under the Enhanced Philippine Seaweed Development Program (EPSDP). Municipal agriculturist Renante Cartaciano led the distribution, along with BFAR-9 regional director Al-Zath Kunting and other local seaweeds experts. Cartaciano […]...
